capabilities: animate cursor movement and blinking in the editor
work on page preview hover and canvas
adjust thickness, color, speed and blink via Style Settings
toggle a smoother translate-based movement mode
extras: README warns the DOM-drawn cursor can cause expensive layout recomputation during frequent movement, and lists known bugs such as buggy multi-cursors in tables. Includes MIT-licensed CodeMirror source code with modifications.
motivation: The author was inspired by the smooth cursor concepts in Microsoft Office and VSCode.
problem: Obsidian's text cursor jumps instantly between positions with no visual movement or blink animation.

relations.evidence: includes some of the source codes developed by Marijnh Haverbeke and the others at CodeMirror
VSCode for the smooth cursor concept.
Adjustable cursor speed and blink duration (via Style Settings plugin).

summary: Cursor animation plugin that adds smooth move and blink animation to Obsidian's text cursor in the editor, canvas and page preview.
